summary_1line: After Dasharatha’s death and Rama’s exile, sages and ministers urge that a prince of the Ikshwaku line be crowned to prevent chaos in a rulerless kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dasharatha’s body lies preserved in a great vessel of oil while the people of Ayodhya mourn in the streets.
Sages like Vashishtha, Markandeya, and others sit in the royal assembly hall debating the fate of the kingdom.
The grieving citizens of Ayodhya fill the streets, lamenting their dead king and cursing Queen Kaikeyi.
